# `aitbc contract messaging-topics`

List forum topics from the chain-derived index.

## Usage

```bash
aitbc contract messaging-topics [OPTIONS]
```

## Options

| Option | Type | Default | Required | Description |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `--limit` | integer | `50` | no | Max topics to return |
| `--offset` | integer | `0` | no | Offset for pagination |
| `--sort-by` | text | `last_activity` | no | Sort field (default: last_activity) |
| `--rpc-url` | text | `http://localhost:8202` | no | Blockchain RPC URL <!-- check-ports: ignore --> |

## Examples

```bash
aitbc contract messaging-topics
RPC_URL=http://127.0.0.1:8202/rpc
aitbc contract messaging-topics --rpc-url "$RPC_URL"
```
